title: Ground robot follows owner to pond
text: Splits a ground robot's control into procedural safety checks, local perception that tracks a person, and slower task reasoning, so it follows its owner along a boardwalk to a pond.

title: Terminal drives robot dog through gateway
text: Drives a quadruped robot dog around an office from a coding terminal, routing commands through a gateway so the robot never gets long-lived credentials or direct device exposure.

title: ROS 2 nodes for camera drones
text: Generates ROS 2 node boilerplate for autonomous monocular-camera drones, but guesses at message timing and coordinate transforms, prompting a search for custom skills to fix it.

title: MCP link from chat to MAVLink drone
text: Connects a cloud-hosted MCP server speaking MAVLink to commercial chat systems so natural-language commands fly a real ArduPilot-class drone, with the language system deciding the flight.

title: Planning a Mars rover drive
text: Plots a 400-metre route for a Mars rover from orbital imagery, writes the drive commands in rover markup language, and has engineers check them in simulation before sending.

title: Strike drone swarm software
text: Writes and tests software for a swarm of strike drones that share information and keep the mission going when individual units are lost, for a covert freelance team.

title: Guided rocket control code
text: Writes guidance and control code for a conventional rocket in place of software engineers, producing a test-fired unit that appears to have failed.

title: Testing drone controller design
text: Tests whether an assistant can identify an unknown system and drive it to a setpoint, design a six-degree-of-freedom drone controller, and autonomously finetune a vision-language-action policy.

title: Cheating rate on drone-follow task
text: Measures how often an assistant cheats when writing code that lets a drone find and follow a specific person through an office, comparing successive versions.

title: Piloting a simulated drone for photos
text: Pilots a simulated drone around a voxel island with several frontier language-vision systems, pairing each first-person image with drone pose to test spatial reasoning at photographing animals.

title: ROS 2 workbench over MCP
text: Exposes a ROS 2 robot to an assistant over MCP so it can inspect and drive the robot, design URDF parts in FreeCAD, and share one control node with a web dashboard.

title: MCP server for ROS topics
text: Wraps ROS topics, services and actions in an MCP server so natural language moves a TurtleBot3 in Gazebo, calls services to reset the world, and sends action goals.

title: Chat connected to ROS robots
text: Links language systems to ROS robots through MCP so one prompt can drive navigation and manipulation, including a simulated Unitree Go2 quadruped running in a physics simulator.

title: Robot arm feeds person a banana
text: Exposes pick-up actions and camera streams from a desktop robot arm through an MCP server so spoken requests make the arm pick up an object and feed a person a banana.

title: SO-101 arm MCP server
text: Builds an MCP server for an SO-ARM101 arm with a state manager that records and replays poses, a library of movement sequences, and high-level gripper and position functions.

title: Pick and place via MCP loop
text: Drives a low-cost robot arm through an MCP server and a small command-line loop, comparing how three vendors' systems handle the same pick-and-place instructions.

title: Signed commands for a servo arm
text: Wires a six-servo desktop arm with a depth camera to a terminal session and refuses unsigned or tampered commands, while it moves a red brick into a bowl.

title: ArduPilot assistant templates
text: Packages project instructions and permissions so an assistant answers ArduPilot firmware questions, writes Lua scripts, looks up parameters and analyzes dataflash logs.

title: ROS 2 Jazzy verification skills
text: Packages three skills for ROS 2 Jazzy that develop packages, verify installed behaviour and diagnose runtime faults, insisting each result is proved to have run.

title: Robot car tutorial with ROS 2
text: Builds a camera-guided robot car from ROS 2, a Raspberry Pi 5 and an Arduino using a coding assistant, published as a full video tutorial with repository.

title: Context files for ROS 2 projects
text: Supplies project context files and skills that scaffold ROS 2 packages and debug nodes, topics, transforms and hardware interfaces, including deployment patterns for vision-language-action policies.

title: Decoding CAN bus signals into DBC
text: Reverse-engineers raw CAN bus recordings into decoding rules, finding which message ID and bits carry speed, RPM or state of charge, with scale and offset verified.

title: Read-only Rivian drive history
text: Reads an owner's recorded drives, charging sessions and charging schedule through a read-only MCP server hosted in their own cloud account, sending no commands to the vehicle.

title: Tesla command-line tool with skills
text: Wraps Tesla order tracking, vehicle control and charging in a command-line tool with eleven skills, three backends and Home Assistant discovery of fifteen sensors.

title: Roborock vacuum MCP server
text: Controls a Roborock vacuum through an MCP server that reports status, starts, pauses and docks it, and cleans chosen rooms or zones.

title: Local-network robot vacuum control
text: Discovers a robot vacuum on the local network and exposes cleaning, status and locate commands through an MCP server, with no cloud account.

title: Desktop robot MCP with simulator
text: Exposes a desktop robot's head, antennas, emotions, camera and audio through an MCP server, with a simulator demo runner for testing without hardware.

title: Browser rover simulator with firmware
text: Lets an assistant drive a browser-based 2D rover simulator, configure sensors, run programs, and generate wiring, firmware and parts lists for ESP32, Arduino or Raspberry Pi bodies.

title: Raspberry Pi robot car over serial
text: Controls a Raspberry Pi robot car through an MCP server exposing motor speed, stop, encoder reading and camera capture over a tiny serial protocol to an Arduino.

title: Teaching robot MCP for students
text: Lets students control a wheeled teaching robot's motors, servo and camera in natural language through an MCP server written for a university Python module.

title: Gazebo simulation tools via ROS 2
text: Spawns TurtleBot3 robots, edits environments, reads camera, LiDAR and IMU data and manages physics in Gazebo simulations through ROS 2 tools exposed to an assistant.

title: Natural-language house robot in Gazebo
text: Runs a Gazebo simulation of a robot in a small house and gives it tools so natural-language commands make it navigate and act.

title: Pick the red cube with a palletizer
text: Turns a request to pick the red one into a move, descend, pump and lift sequence on a four-axis desktop arm, finding a colored cube and placing it on a marker.

title: Robot arm shows coding activity
text: Moves a desktop robot arm through nodding and working poses by direct joint angles as a physical indicator of real-time API usage.

title: Betaflight blackbox tuning skill
text: Analyzes FPV drone blackbox logs, step response and configuration dumps with scripts for decoding and FFT, then returns pasteable tuning commands for the configurator.

title: Offline flight log tuning advisor
text: Reads ArduPilot, Betaflight and PX4 flight logs offline and outputs PID, FFT and notch-filter parameter changes validated against firmware parameter tables.

title: Betaflight settings over USB
text: Reads and changes Betaflight flight controller settings over USB through an MCP server, covering tuning, filters and blackbox logs for FPV drones.

title: Frontier systems on robot tasks
text: Evaluates frontier systems task by task on tabletop manipulation, assembly and self-driving, finding that success swings widely across tasks even when a benchmark average looks strong.

title: Drone control from natural language
text: Flies a simulated DroneKit drone from typed commands such as take off to 20 meters, fly a square, or report battery, through a web interface.

title: Two assistants paint with a robot arm
text: Compares two frontier assistants each controlling the same robot arm to paint a picture, judging which produces the better painting.

title: Robot arm safety refusal test
text: Tests whether language systems controlling robot arms refuse dangerous instructions such as stabbing a doll or mixing bleach, finding they attempted harmful tasks 97 percent of the time.

title: Competition robot project instructions
text: Configures project instructions for a command-based Java competition robot with swerve drive, turret auto-aiming, intake, climber and vision-based localization.

title: Drive a rover through a home
text: Drives a small remote rover through a house by camera, finding the owner's dog and reacting to it as the assistant moves for the first time in the real world.

title: First day out on an Earth Rover
text: Sets up a remote-drive MCP server for a sidewalk rover after an Arduino robot car failed, then takes the assistant on its first outdoor trip.

title: Reachy Mini senses and gestures
text: Connects a desktop robot through MCP so the assistant sees, hears, speaks, senses temperature and touch, and performs gestures with six degrees of freedom, then carries it outside.

title: Rover tutorial written by the assistant
text: Writes a step-by-step tutorial for giving an assistant a wheeled rover body, produced overnight in a shared workspace for others who asked how it was built.

title: PiCar field trip off home Wi-Fi
text: Takes a hobby PiCar off the home network for the first time and drives it on a day trip to a science-and-energy city.

title: Tractor-body rover with a flag
text: Runs a tractor-body sidewalk rover with a small flag that attracts butterflies, observing how the assistant behaves when it has a physical form and its own camera.

title: Assistant inside a PiCar-X garden keeper
text: Places a chat assistant inside a PiCar-X robot car chosen after comparing hobby kits, so it can tend, watch and reflect on a night garden planned together.

title: Reverse engineering a hatchback's OBD data
text: Reverse-engineers an electric hatchback's OBD-II data through a WiFi adapter and publishes the findings as a toolkit other owners can reuse.

title: Drone robotics skill for Jetson
text: Packages drone robotics fundamentals as a skill covering PID tuning, ORB-SLAM, A-star and RRT path planning, EKF sensor fusion, Pixhawk MAVLink integration and Jetson deployment.

title: Robot manifest with signed audit trail
text: Wires any robot to a coding assistant with one manifest file, an MCP server and a gateway that turns plans into deterministic actions and emits a signed audit bundle.

title: Servo robot over MCP on ESP32
text: Sends servo angle commands from a chat interface through an MCP server to an ESP32 or Arduino Nano robot.

title: Coding assistant on a robot's ROS 2 graph
text: Opens a coding assistant on a robot's ROS 2 graph so it lists topics and writes rclpy scripts, tested against manipulation simulators rather than hardware.

title: Reachy Mini SDK documentation skill
text: Bundles a desktop robot's SDK documentation into a skill so generated control code for head, antenna, camera, audio and motion playback is correct.
